_: The Cloudflare gate: the shipped source, type-checked with the RUNTIME's own types in scope — the message an Email Worker is handed is the one ./inbound.ts names structurally, and a Worker's fetch is the one ./cloudflare.ts calls through. `deno check --config packages/mail/workers.json packages/mail/conform.ts` is the check; it is part of `deno task check`. It stands alone because those types are global: in scope, every other file in the repo would be checked against a Worker it does not run in.
